**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Governing law (§ 11, p0043):** "the laws of the Arizona" — Arizona is outside the accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England and Wales), so this fails the fallback on a material term.
- **Forum (§ 19, p0056):** No court venue is specified anywhere; instead all disputes go to mandatory binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules. Because the arbitration is domestic rather than seated abroad, this is a deviation rather than walk-away territory.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** New York law plus exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, substituted for the arbitration forum so the two clauses are consistent. Only the jurisdiction words and forum were touched; the severability and award-confirmation language is untouched. Delaware, California or England and Wales courts remain available as a fallback if RadialSpark pushes back.
